decision.summary: A transient multi-axis offset begins at index 422, strongest in E (≈−6 MAD) and N (≈−2 to −4 MAD), with smaller U dip; recovery initiates around 431–432 but is incomplete and ambiguous in E by index 434 (last observed within allowed context). No opposing return is confirmed before context ends at 465, so the interval is marked uncertain.

intervals.observation: N and E show a multi-sample negative excursion starting ~422, with E dropping ~−6 MAD and N ~−2 to −4 MAD; U dips modestly. The offset sustains through 429–430, then begins recovery: E shows partial return by 432 but remains offset at 433–434; N recovers more clearly by 433. Return is incomplete and ambiguous in E by end of allowed context (465), so status is uncertain.
